messages:
Priya: heads-up  I'm seeing several tutorials and SDK snippets using different words for the same thing (prompt / input / prompt_text / instruction). New users are getting tripped up. Can we pick a canonical API param and update snippets?
Marco: Agree. Picking one helps test coverage too. My vote: `user_input` as the canonical param. It's explicit and maps to gen/chat/embeddings.
Anya: `user_input` works. Suggest we also add a short style rule: when writing prose use 'instruction' only if it's an imperative directive; use 'prompt' in informal quickstarts but prefer 'user_input' in API code.
Tim: Logging a small concern: some existing SDK versions expose `prompt` for backwards compat. We should show a tiny compatibility example in migration docs and keep snippets showing old->new for one release.
Priya: good point. Plan: 1) update canonical code snippets to `user_input`; 2) add a migration note and example (old -> new); 3) add a docs linter rule to flag deprecated names in code fences; 4) publish a glossary blurb explaining prompt/instruction/user_input.
Marco: For the linter, I'll prototype a docs-mdcheck rule that errors on `prompt_text|\bprompt\b|\binput\b` inside triple-backtick code blocks. It can optionally offer an autofix to `user_input`.
Anya: I'll draft the glossary blurb. Draft text: "user_input  raw text provided by the end user. Use 'instruction' for imperative, model-facing directives; 'prompt' may be used casually in quickstarts but avoid it in API reference." I'll attach that to the PR.
Tim: I'll prepare the migration snippet tests for JS and Python and add CI snippet-tests so we catch regressions. Example to add to migration guide:
```js
// old
client.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize this article' })
// new
client.generate({ user_input: 'Summarize this article' })
```
```py
# old
client.generate(prompt_text='Summarize this article')
# new
client.generate(user_input='Summarize this article')
```
Priya: DocsBot, can you run a scoped scan for code fences under /docs/examples and /docs/snippets and open PRs for obvious matches? Please skip prose matches.
DocsBot: queued: scanning /docs/examples and /docs/snippets for deprecated param names in code fences. Will open fix PRs and post links.
ProductLead: quick ask  add a short release-note item so PMs can confirm the user-facing wording. We should also add a one-release Console hint: keep the label "Prompt" but show tiny help text "API param: user_input (formerly prompt)".
Marco: noted. I'll add release-note checklist and tag @product-review.
Anya: action items recap: Marco  docs-mdcheck rule + release-note checklist; Tim  snippet-tests and CI; Priya  PR to update snippets and migration paragraph + Console tooltip ticket; DocsBot  scan & open fix branches; Anya  glossary blurb.
Priya: timeline: let's aim to land snippet PRs and glossary within this sprint. We'll keep old param names working in SDKs for one release and show both names in examples until deprecation completes. I'll merge after CI green and then post a short changelog blurb. :thumbsup:
